title: Pursa Qubool Karlo Moula Imam e Kazim
body:
Pursa qubool karlo moula imam e Kazim.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaffer ke gham may hai ye duniya imam e Kazim.
1.Jaffer ko zeher dekay ummat ne zulm dhaaya.
Zeher e dagha diya hai kaisa imam e Kazim.....
2.Mansoor ne diya hai jaffer ko zeher jab se.
Dil khoon hogaya hai sabka imam e Kazim.....
3.Shiyon ke aaj chehre murjhagaye hain saare.
Jaffer ka gham bapa hai harja imam e Kazim.....
4.Jaffer ke gham may roolo Sarwar pa roone walo.
Denge duaon tumko aaqa imam e Kazim.....
5.Akbar ke matami jo jaffer ke gham may aaye.
Deti hai ab duayein zehra imam e Kazim.
6.Dawar ki yeh dua hai jaffer ki qabr dekhe. or joun bhi padhe ye nouha imam e Kazim.....
<<MINI>>
Pursa qubool karlo moula imam e Kazim.
<<DIVIDER>>
Azz:-dawar Ali dawar
